terms_evidence.release: Official README states public domain, Distribution A approved for public release/distribution unlimited, as-is and without warranty.

deterministic_selection.candidate_unit: canonical provider hostname + UTC calendar day + source run/file + contiguous window start
deterministic_selection.eligibility: Host has at least two complete benign-only UTC days before red-team activity and at least one complete day intersecting a documented red-team interval; selected files pass pinned errata and process/file/socket coverage checks.
deterministic_selection.host_order: Sort original provider hostname bytes in UTF-8 order before keyed de-identification; choose first 8 eligible hosts. Persist de-identification mapping hash in the materialized manifest.
deterministic_selection.day_order: For each host, choose two earliest complete benign-only days and the earliest complete ground-truth-overlap day.
deterministic_selection.window_rule: Within each host/day/run, choose the earliest contiguous 3600-second UTC window passing the record-count/loss audit; overlap day must intersect at least one independent ground-truth interval.
deterministic_selection.group_boundary: Each selected host/day/run/window is one indivisible group. Do not split events, process objects, or overlapping windows across partitions.
deterministic_selection.selection_failure: Fewer than 8 eligible hosts, incomplete windows, missing ground truth, or failed errata/coverage blocks acquisition and invokes REQUEST_SMALLER_OR_DIFFERENT_SUBSET.

expected_provider_object_identity.expected_identity_rule: The acquisition operator must record the provider object ID, exact filename/path, provider revision/ETag if available, byte length, and source folder for every selected file. Nulls are intentional until a human-approved manifest is created.

checksum_and_size.checksum_method: Hash exact provider bytes before decompression and again every extracted file; hash canonical ordered manifest JSON with sorted keys/compact separators; retain byte lengths and provider object IDs.

size_caps.overflow_action: Stop transfer and request a smaller/different subset; no silent truncation.

label_expectations.availability: Expected from official release documentation; exact provider object identity and checksum are unknown until approved manifesting.

roles.ground_truth_overlap_window: positive only for records independently aligned to the documented red-team interval; unaligned background remains negative
roles.calibration: groups assigned by the frozen R5 hash split, never formal material

label_expectations.label_quality_gate: Every positive label must cite a ground-truth artifact/page or interval, source record identity, and alignment method; missing or ambiguous alignment quarantines the group.
label_expectations.encoder_boundary: No label, ground-truth field, red-team interval, host name, run ID, action identity, or outcome enters x.

rules: Apply pinned OpTC errata before record admission.
Canonicalize event/action tokens into the R3 event classes; unknown tokens map to other and are counted.
Construct process/file/socket entities and causal edges only from collector-visible actor/object relationships.
Normalize timestamp_ms to UTC epoch milliseconds and preserve deterministic node/edge ordering.
De-identify host/path/user values before split assignment; mapping key and source IDs are metadata only.
Persist rejected records, duplicate coalescing, node_map, edge_map, normalization_map, raw keys, and finite-tensor checks.

stop_conditions: any provider object ID, exact path, or checksum remains null at transfer time
selection criteria cannot be satisfied without post-hoc relaxation
per-object/extracted checksum mismatch or partial transfer
20 GiB compressed or 50 GiB expanded cap is exceeded
ground-truth alignment is missing or ambiguous
pinned errata, source revision, or terms cannot be verified
FA1B2de/1796-action overlap or Track O evaluation metadata is detected
normalization cannot produce finite 32D features with complete audit counters
